name: DevProNestNyx
description: Independent DEV MCP instance; does not replace or deploy the YaRoute production service

NYX_API_KEY.description: Secret key required in the X-Nyx-Key header for the REST API.

NYX_PUBLIC_URL.description: HTTPS origin of NEW dedicated DevProNestNyx Heroku app, not production.

NYX_OAUTH_ISSUER.description: OAuth/OIDC issuer URL used by ChatGPT to authorize access to the MCP server.

NYX_OAUTH_AUDIENCE.description: Unique audience for this DEV MCP resource; do not reuse production audience.

NYX_OAUTH_JWKS_URI.description: Optional JWKS endpoint override. Leave unset for issuer/.well-known/jwks.json.

NYX_OAUTH_SCOPES.description: Comma-separated MCP scopes. Defaults to nyx.read,nyx.write.

RCLONE_CONFIG_B64.description: DEV-only rclone config. Do NOT paste or reuse production credentials without explicit authorization.

NYX_SHARED_ROOTS_JSON.description: DEV/test logical root mapping. Do NOT point at production-write data.

NYX_INIT_AREA.description: Logical NYX_SHARED_ROOTS_JSON alias used for canonical Nyx/Yaro initialization. MAIN should point to the primary Google Drive root.

NYX_PATHS_REGISTRY_PATH.description: Relative path below NYX_INIT_AREA to the mutable paths.md bootstrap registry.

NYX_AREAS_ROOT_PATH.description: Relative path below NYX_INIT_AREA containing operational Area folders used by targeted initialization.

NYX_YARO_PREFIX.description: Relative YaRoute root below NYX_INIT_AREA. Current initialization also resolves the live 3_template overlays and Template map/index.

NYX_SERVICE_NAME.description: Non-secret identity used by health and OAuth resource metadata.

NYX_DEPLOYMENT_MODE.description: DEV instance starts private; never enable public connectors before tenant-isolated security checks.

NYX_PUBLIC_CONNECTORS_ENABLED.description: Keep DEV shared storage tools private.

NYX_PRIVATE_OAUTH_SUBJECTS.description: Comma-separated allow-listed owner OAuth subjects; configure separately from production. DO NOT use public tenants.

NYX_STORAGE_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Distinct encryption key for this DEV instance. Generate locally; do not reuse production.

DATABASE_URL.description: DEV-only PostgreSQL connection string (distinct DB from production). Set in Heroku private config vars.
